_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

open_questions: Base rate (re-checked 2026-11-07, still open): the issuer states earn only for domestic travel (1 point per ₹100, T&C 3.4(a), MCC list) and for flight and hotel bookings on the RBL rewards portal (5 per ₹100, T&C 3.4(b)); the product page ("Reward Points that Power Your Next Adventure"), the application-form KFS, the MITC, the Rewards Programme T&C (3.1 "accrual varies for each Credit Card", 5.4 "as defined in respective product terms") and the card list say nothing about any other eligible spend. T&C 3.4(d) lists categories that are "not eligible to earn", which implies other spend might earn, but no rate is printed. base_points_per_block and the return percent are left null and no non-travel earn rule is drafted. Action: ask RBL in writing (cardservices@rbl.bank.in, toll free 1800 102 6222) whether everyday non-travel spend earns points and at what rate, or have the product owner decide to publish the card as travel-only earn.

Network (resolved 2026-11-07): RBL's own network availability guide (issuer page, undated) ticks World Safari Lite for MasterCard, RuPay and Visa, so it is recorded as a multi-network card with card_product.network left null. Which network a new customer is issued is not stated; the T&C only says "MasterCard/RuPay/VISA" generically. On the RuPay variant, the Rewards Programme T&C (5.4) says offline UPI transactions under ₹2,000 at small merchants earn no base points, voucher or milestone benefits.
International travel: only "domestic travel" earns 1 point per ₹100; whether international airline, hotel or transport spend earns anything is not stated.

Welcome benefit: T&C 3.2(c) conditions the voucher on paying the "first month membership fees", while the page says the annual fee; the card carries an annual fee. Ixigo offer valid to 31 Dec 2026 per the welcome T&C.
Milestone tiers: T&C 3.5(b) says "additional 10,000" points at ₹5 lakh; it is not stated whether this adds to the 5,000 at ₹2.5 lakh. Rupee values use the ₹0.05 baseline (₹0.25 would be 5x).

Lounge: T&C 3.3.1 requires ₹50,000 spend in the same calendar quarter for the international voucher; 3.3.2 and the page tie the domestic visit to the previous quarter. The page says one visit per quarter "within and outside India".
Points value for flights and hotels is ₹0.25, so the 5X earn is a 1.25% return only if redeemed on flights or hotels; at ₹0.05 it is 0.25%.
Reward point expiry is the Rewards Programme T&C rule (24 months, RWD 5.1); the product T&C is silent.

Finance charge: MITC says "up to 3.99% per month (47.88% a year)" for these cards and then lists bureau-score bands (above 775: 3.35% a month; 725-775: 3.85%; below 725: 3.99%). The draft stores the 3.99% maximum.
